meta.description: F2L case library volume 3 — VLS subsets, HLS, multislotting, all U-layer AUF variants, ZBLS, MGLS, misc edge cases
notes: VLS has 8 subsets x 27 cases = 216 total. We cover the key cases per subset.
HLS mirrors VLS with RUR' insert instead of RU'R'.
AUF variants: same pair, different U-layer pre-alignment needed.
ZBLS: last slot + orient last layer edges.
MGLS: last slot + solve last layer in fewer looks.
All setups assume white cross bottom, target slot FR.

misc_edge_cases.description: Miscellaneous edge cases not covered elsewhere — parity-adjacent states, pieces in D layer, unique extraction patterns.

cases.label: Corner in D layer (fell through) — extract with D move
cases.setup: R U' R' U R U' R' D R U R' D'
algs: D R U R' D'
R D R' U' R D' R'
cases.note: Rare but happens if a previous alg goes wrong. D move extracts the corner.

cases.label: Edge in D layer (fell through, only possible by mistake)
cases.setup: D' F' U F D
algs: D' F' U' F D
F D F' D' then standard
cases.note: Should not happen in normal solve — edge in D layer indicates prior error.

cases.label: Corner misoriented in solved D layer slot — white NOT facing down
cases.setup: R U R' U' R U' R' (triple trigger sets up)
algs: (R U R' U') x3
R U2 R' U R U2 R'
cases.note: Called the sexy-move loop. Three repetitions of R U R' U' fixes a twisted corner.

cases.label: Edge oriented wrong in D layer slot (flipped middle layer edge)
cases.setup: R U R' U' R U R' F R' F' R
algs: R U' R' F' R U R' U' R' F R
F R U R' U' F' R U' R'
cases.note: Middle layer edge flip. Needs F or B move to correct orientation.

cases.label: Both pieces in U, but already paired incorrectly (wrong-color pseudo-pair)
cases.setup: R U' L' U R' U' L
algs: U R U' R' U L' U' L
R U' R' L' U L U' y R U' R' y'
cases.note: Corner and edge are touching but don't match. Must separate before pairing correct pieces.

cases.label: FR slot half-open — only corner solved, edge missing entirely from slot
algs: U' F' U F
y' U R' U' R
F' U2 F
cases.note: Same as ELS but more general — just need to insert the edge cleanly.

cases.label: FR slot half-open — only edge solved, corner missing from slot
algs: R U' R' U R U R'
R U2 R' U' R U' R'
cases.note: Same as CLS. Insert corner without disturbing the existing edge.

cases.label: Cross-1 — one cross edge still unsolved, F2L pair available
algs: Depends on which cross edge is missing — M' U2 M or F U F' style
cases.note: Cross-1 technique. Allows M-slice usage in F2L. Inserts the last cross edge and F2L pair together.

cases.label: Forced F2L — all 4 F2L pieces are in the U layer (best case start)
algs: Plan all 4 insertions during inspection
Solve in order of difficulty: easy pairs first
cases.note: All pieces available at once. Lookahead determines optimal pair order.

cases.label: Skip — F2L pair already solved after cross
algs: (no moves required)
cases.note: Lucky case — pair was inserted during cross solution. Occurs ~1 in 40 pairs.

cases.label: OLL-during-F2L — last pair setup coincidentally orients LL
algs: Recognize by looking at LL corner orientations before final insert
cases.note: If LL corners are favorable, choose a WV/VLS alg over standard F2L insert.

cases.label: F2L at wrong slot — correct pair inserted into wrong slot by mistake
algs: R U R' (extract)
AUF
re-insert correctly
cases.note: Common beginner/intermediate mistake. Extract with R U R', then AUF and reinsert.
